# Topics bin/run records on the perception computer (ros2 bag record).
# Light ones only: no point clouds, no images. One per line; # starts a comment.
# Kept in a file so no Nav2 program name ever lands on a command line
# (memory: the marker-word trap). README "Measuring a run".

# where he thought he was, by each source
/odom_fused
/leg_odom2
/lio_odom
/amcl_pose
/localized
/tf_static
# not /tf: 50 Hz of mostly odom -> base_link, which /odom_fused already is; it
# took the recorder (the `ros2` process) from 13% to 11% of a core (2026-10-14)

# what Nav2 wanted and did
/cmd_vel
/plan
/navigate_to_pose/_action/status
/global_costmap/costmap

# what he saw, and his state (gait, battery)
/scan_walls
/scan
/robot_state_debug
